summary: Alphabet Inc. filed a prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an offering of 167.5 million Series B Depositary Shares, each representing a 1/20th interest in a share of 6.25% Series B Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock, at $50.00 per depositary share, raising approximately $8.29 billion in proceeds. Each preferred share has a $1,000 liquidation preference, pays cumulative dividends at 6.25% payable quarterly in cash or Class C stock, and mandatorily converts into between 2.2740 and 2.8420 shares of Class C capital stock by May 2029 based on VWAP. Underwriters have a 30-day option for an additional 25 million depositary shares. This is a routine equity-linked capital markets transaction, not a special situation; no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is involved.
